name: Seasonal Picks
description: Picks movies from your watch history and the time of year.
overview: History- and calendar-aware movie picks as playlists (works on TV), a shared Suggested library, themed seasonal covers and a web Suggested screen.

versions.changelog: Season rows on the settings page are no longer squashed: the name and dates show in full, and on phones the badges and the On box move to a second line. The settings page uses more of a wide screen, and the Picks settings sit in three tidy columns. Buttons such as Remove and Upload picture are readable again, and "Remove finished cover" only shows when there is an uploaded cover. What's new loads again on Jellyfin 12.1. On phones, the chosen tab scrolls into view. The Suggested screen fills the whole screen in older browsers.

Seasonal Picks now has its own entry in the dashboard side menu. New look for the settings page: tabs, a header showing what's on today and what's next, and seasons that fold up into a one-line summary with a cover thumbnail. The Save buttons stay at the bottom of the screen while you scroll. This changelog, under What's new.
